citations.title: Rippling Expands New York City Presence Amid Accelerated Growth
excerpts: **Rippling Expands New York City Presence Amid Accelerated Growth** Share * * _New 132,000-square-foot office at 330 West 34th Street will support the company as it expands its AI-powered platform, launches new products & invests in teams worldwide._ NEW YORK--( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )-- ​Rippling, the AI-native workforce management platform, announces the opening of its new New York City office, marking a significant expansion of its presence in one of the world’s leading business and technology hubs. The new office reflects Rippling’s continued momentum as the company scales its AI-powered platform, expands its global workforce, and invests in the teams and infrastructure needed to build the future of business software. > We have an ambitious vision to build an AI platform that helps organizations run their people, technology, and finance operations. Delivering on that requires top-tier talent, and New York is one of the strongest talent pools in the world. > > Share Located at 330 West 34th Street, the new 132,693-square-foot office will support more than 1,000 employees across go-to-market, engineering, product and design, operations, and corporate functions, among others. The new location nearly doubles Rippling’s previous New York footprint of 67,000 square feet, providing additional capacity for future growth as the company continues to scale.
